item.title: Long-term training continually fine tunes motor memories
item.content:encoded:
Nature Human Behaviour, Published online: 11 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41562-026-02637-8

Humans’ rapid adaptation to new dynamics is a crucial ability for interacting with the world. By combining the controlled manipulations of sensorimotor adaptation studies with the long-term learning approach of complex tasks, this study shows that the learned motor memory is continually tuned, and that retention increases with long-term training.
